builds.name: Good Always Triumphs!
builds.desc:
Now, looking at this build, you might be tempted to write of Cynthia as a generic Galeforce sweeper. And you'd be right, she is. But really, if you're here it's probably more-so for Cynthia's Kamen Rider inspired personality rather than building an amazing, meta shattering build, and nothing quite says doling out justice like abusing Slaying Lance+'s cooldown reduction combined with a Heavy Blade 3 seal to wreck havoc on multiple baddies in a single turn by setting up a one turn Galeforce on any malcontents who are doubled and weaker than our heroine (just make sure the sneak isn't carrying any CD disrupting skills such as Steady Stance 4). A Spd or Atk refine will work, depending on preference and specific needs. Smacking villains around with a bundle of flowers by running Lofty Blossoms+ is also a viable option if one is comfortable with taking damage in exchange for a boost to Atk and Spd, though it lacks the long term consistency of Slaying Lance+ and lacks synergy with Desperation 3, and as such is not recommended for lengthy maps or for summoners with allergies.
The choice in A skill comes down to preference, Atk/Spd Solo 3 gives consistency over drawn out skirmishes against the forces of evil while Atk/Spd Push 4 gives one flexibility in positioning and a slight stat increase. Really though, one can just throw any A skill here, so long as it boosts Cynthia's so-so Atk and Spd up to the point where she can consistently double and trigger Heavy Blade 3.
The preferred B passive is Desperation 3, in part because it allows Cynthia to deal damage without fear of being taken out in retaliation by the heavy hitting ne'er-do-wells she might have to administer a heaping serving of righteous fury to, in part because she's a flying hero and as such has practically no other viable options for this slot.
You'll want to use your C skill to boost Cynthia's admittedly modest Atk further, and while many skills work in this regard, Even Atk Wave 3 is a perfectly fine f2p option. If one is will to spend a few orbs, skills such as Threat. Atk/Spd 3 and Atk/Def Oath 3 are also great choices. And, of course, as a flyer Cynthia is perfectly capable of supporting her fellow vanguards of valor with movement skills such as Air Orders 3, Guidance 3, and Ground Orders 3, though do beware that these do not assist in the primary function of this build (to violently stomp out ill-doings and allow justice to prevail).
